title: What it tests
items: Whether you can ship an LLM feature that works for real users
That you measure quality, not just demo it
That you know what it costs and what fails first

title: Common prompts
items: Search or Q&A over documents, with citations
Memory and a knowledge base for agents
Generating slides, audio or images from a brief

title: Strong answers cover
items: Cost per user and a latency budget

title: Expect to be asked
items: How you'd evaluate it, before and after launch
Cost per user, latency budget for model calls
Fallback when a model provider fails
Ship a thin pilot fast, then keep, hand over or close
